drums.tags: Industrial metal with cinematic orchestral elements. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs in drop tuning. A heavy drum kit features a gated snare and double-kick patterns. Orchestral strings and brass stabs provide rhythmic accents. Synthesizers contribute distorted bass pulses and high-frequency glitch textures. The arrangement uses sudden dynamic shifts and mechanical sound effects. 120 BPM, 4/4 time signature, D minor.

[Intro]
[distorted synth bass pulse]
[mechanical sound effects]
[orchestral brass stabs]

[Section A]
[palm-muted distorted guitar chugging]
[heavy kick drum and gated snare]
[staccato string section accents]

[Section B]
[double-kick drum patterns]
[sustained distorted guitar power chords]
[high-pitched synth glitch textures]

[Outro]
[sudden silence]
[reverb tail of final brass hit]

bass.tags: Hard rock instrumental. The track features a prominent, dry acoustic drum kit with a crisp snare and resonant kick. A distorted electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted riff centered around a low E pedal tone. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic counterpoint with staccato chords. The bass guitar is heavily overdriven, doubling the main guitar riff with a thick, mid-range presence. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the percussive guitar chugging and the steady drum beat.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[drum fill, snare and kick]
[distorted electric guitar enters with palm-muted riff]
[overdriven bass guitar enters, doubling the riff]

[Main Section]
[staccato clean electric guitar chords on the off-beats]
[steady drum beat with eighth-note hi-hats]
[distorted guitar continues syncopated riffing]

[Outro]
[instruments sustain and fade out]
